patch_description: The previous 38-parameter architecture introduced increased complexity without performance gains, resulting in lower test accuracy and a higher convergence step count. This edit reverts to the proven, high-performing 26-parameter structure from the initial seed, which achieved better generalization and efficiency. This structure uses coarse-grained parameter sharing across two 4-qubit banks (0-3 vs 4-7) and a balanced entanglement pattern that has historically demonstrated optimal convergence.
